title: NYC AI Summit — travel & expenses scratchpad
body:
Notes to self / scratchpad for NYC AI Summit (Mar 22-24 2026). Mix of admin, vendor contacts, expense reminders, and quick agenda items.

Trip overview:
- Purpose: attend AI Summit, run a short demo at booth B12, meet with two partners (EdgeAccel, CloudHub), capture latency/cost benchmarks.
- Travel days: depart 2026-03-21 (red-eye option?), return 2026-03-25.
- Company card: Redwood Corp - AMEX ending 4312 (use for hotels & ground). Personal card for incidentals then reimburse.

Itinerary (high level):
- 2026-03-21: Fly SFO -> JFK (red-eye UA287, arrive 06:30). Track bag allowance for demo hardware (2 small GPUs in pelican case).
- 2026-03-22: Summit day 1 — booth set up 07:00, keynote 09:30, partner dinners 19:00 (EdgeAccel).
- 2026-03-23: Summit day 2 — panels, demos 11:00-13:00, customer meeting with CloudHub 15:00 at Convene (reserve room).
- 2026-03-24: Summit day 3 — wrap up, teardown by 15:00. Flight back evening or next morning based on energy.

Immediate TODOs (before travel):
- [ ] Upload demo VM image to s3 and ensure access keys rotated (ticket INF-4221).
- [ ] Print out two booth one-pagers + business cards (see vendor: PrintFast NYC). Confirm pickup time.
- [ ] Confirm EdgeAccel dinner menu (vegetarian options) and dietary notes for Sofia. 
- [ ] Reserve Convene room for 15:00 on 03-23 (contact: Convene Events mgr).
- [ ] Pack dongles, spare HDMI, power strip, and travel power bricks in carry-on.
- [ ] Scan employee travel policy to ensure per-diem / per-night cap match billing: hotel cap $325/night in NYC.

Expense categories & reminders for reimbursement (use these codes in Expensify):
- Meals (team dinners) — EXP-CAT: TR-MEAL-REDWOOD. Need itemized receipt (no corporate card) or per-diem exception.
- Lodging — EXP-CAT: TR-HOTEL. Put AMEX corporate first; if personal used, add statement + folio.
- Ground transport (Uber, taxi, rideshare, subway) — EXP-CAT: TR-TRANS. Capture screenshot + credit card last4.
- Shipping (demo hardware to venue) — EXP-CAT: TR-SHIP. Save tracking + manifest. Vendor: FedEx account ending 9921.
- Booth materials (print + swag) — EXP-CAT: TR-MKT. Attach invoice from PrintFast NYC.
- Misc (parking, tips, baggage fees) — EXP-CAT: TR-OTHER. Add short note.

Receipt & documentation checklist:
- Scan receipts with mobile app (Expensify) immediately. Name receipts like: "NYC-03-22-EdgeAccel-dinner.pdf".
- For hotel folios, request the itemized folio at checkout and email to finance@redwood.ai within 72 hours.
- For shipped demo gear, photo of packing list + FedEx label required for reimbursement.
- Keep boarding passes (mobile screenshot ok).

Vendors & contacts (quick list):
- PrintFast NYC — Contact: Miguel Torres, miguel@printfastnyc.com, +1-212-555-0147. Pickup at 9am on 03-21 at 44th St. Invoice to: accounts@printfastnyc.com (PO: RDW-PO-778).
- Convene Midtown — Events mgr: Rachel Nguyen, rachel@convene.com, +1-646-555-0199. Room 6B reserved tentative. Billing question: will accept company tax-exempt form? (ask finance).
- FedEx (corporate services) — acct rep: Jerome Blake, jerome.blake@fedex.com, +1-800-123-4567, acct 9921 (for demo hardware outbound/inbound).
- Hotel: Arlo Nomad — reservation under "Redwood / Ava Martinez" (confirmation AA12345NYC). Front desk phone +1-212-555-0123. Note: early check-in may be charged.

Conference logistics and ops notes:
- Booth B12 dims: 8x6 ft. Table provided; need skirt + two stools. Order skirt from venue by 03-10 to avoid rush fee.
- AV: HDMI + 3.5mm audio. Bring miniDP->HDMI adapter. Test demo on venue projector day before.
- Power: single dedicated 110V outlet; bring power strip and QoS for router. Consider battery UPS for demo (10 min).
- Internet: venue Wi‑Fi is flaky. Plan 4G hotspot (AT&T) and verify SIM. Test fallback to LTE tether.

Partner meetings & prep:
- EdgeAccel (03-22 dinner): prep slides (2 slides): partnership benefits + 6-week POC scope. Bring NDA physical? we can sign via DocuSign instead.
- CloudHub (03-23 15:00): bring 1-page latency/cost summary for hosted vs dedicated trials. Ask about their security reqs for Private deployments (VPC, KMS).

Packing notes (hardware):
- Demo laptop (company MacBook Pro 16) + power brick
- Pelican case: 2x A100 40GB equivalent modules + 1x NVMe external + labels
- USB-C hub, adapter kit, spare SSD (encrypted), cable bag

Onsite roles (who does what):
- Ava: lead demo, logistics, receipts collector
- Liam: technical backup, metrics capture (latency), camera for booth shots
- Sofia: partner engagement, scheduling follow-ups, note taking

Post-trip follow ups:
- Submit expenses in Expensify within 7 days of return. Tag manager for approval: "Jordan Lee".
- Upload demo telemetry and summary to Confluence page RDW-ops/ai-summit-2026/after-action.
- Email leads met with a short follow-up template: subject "Great to meet at AI Summit — Redwood follow-up". Attach benchmark PDF.

Open questions / items to resolve:
- Who signs off on Booth budget exceeding $1,200? (Is PM OK or needs ops director?)
- Confirm whether we can ship demo gear on company FedEx account without extra customs paperwork for international partners (EdgeAccel has folks from Toronto).
- Confirm wifi + static IP purchase price from venue — budget line?

Random scratchy notes (fragments):
- "Get extra business cards — new logo pull seems slightly off color."
- "Ask finance about automated per-diem for >3 day travel (avoid lots of small meal claims)."
- "Remember to mute Slack pings — set OOO for Mar22-24 but keep phone on for urgent partner calls."

Quick templates (to copy/paste):
- Expense memo: "Attended AI Summit NYC (Mar 22-24). Expenses include hotel, airfare, booth materials, and partner dinners. Receipts attached. Purpose: business dev + product demo. Request reimbursement under TR-2026-Q1."
- Follow-up email template: "Hi <Name>, great connecting at AI Summit. As discussed, please find attached a short summary of Redwood Inference demo and suggested next steps. Happy to schedule a 30m follow-up next week. — Ava"

End of scratchpad. Update as things change.
